notes: Accordion SoundTrail now covers 43 researched styles and 155 verified accordion recordings.

Added Finnish Tango, Country / Americana Accordion, Polish-American Polka, Malagasy Accordion, Serbian Kolo, Norwegian Gammaldans, Swedish Folk / Dragspel, Panamanian Típico / Pindín, Romanian Lăutărească, Macedonian Oro, and Bulgarian Horo Accordion.
Every Accordion style now includes what-to-listen-for guidance, a common instrument/setup note, and a practical learning focus.
SoundTrail now enforces at least two unique verified Spotify track examples per researched style, with three or more preferred when strong examples are available.
Added an additive Yellowdawg migration so learner metadata survives the Supabase-first runtime path.
Clarified related squeezebox systems such as diatonic button accordion, bayan, Schwyzerörgeli, trikitixa, and bandoneón instead of treating their fingering as interchangeable with piano accordion.
